policies.cohort: Exactly the five verified_public_sources sites in the 2026-10-29 catalog; their primary grids only.
policies.analysis_unit: Distinct primary ERA5 grid; shared site links do not create additional climate observations or independent episodes.
policies.threshold: Daily maximum HI >= 40.6 Celsius, using unrounded decoded daily values.
policies.season: June 1 through August 31, UTC+8; 92 unique finite daily values required per summer.
policies.episode: A maximal run of consecutive threshold-reaching calendar days within one JJA; one-day episodes are retained. This is not an independent-event assumption or an official heatwave definition.
policies.incomplete_season: Keep annual completeness diagnostics, but withhold all threshold episodes and annual threshold/run metrics for incomplete summers.
policies.season_censoring: An episode touching June 1 or August 31 is flagged at that edge; duration is observed within JJA and may omit continuation outside the season.
policies.episode_peak_tie: Choose the earliest date among equal daily HI peaks.
policies.annual_distribution: Min, 25th percentile, median, 75th percentile and max of complete-summer annual metrics; quantiles use numpy method=linear. These are empirical distributions, not confidence intervals.
policies.typical_year: Minimize absolute distance from the median annual threshold-day count; choose the earliest year if tied. All tied candidates are retained.
policies.extreme_year: Maximize annual threshold-day count, then maximize annual longest run among tied years, then choose the earliest year. Both tie stages are retained.
policies.selection_status: Analysis rules specified before this module calculated new case results; existing summary values were already known, so this is not a prospective preregistration.
policies.masked_primary: Withhold daily, annual and episode results on non-land primary grids; do not substitute a sensitivity grid.
